```{r}
library(surveydown)
```

--- welcome

# Welcome

This survey asks about your car.

```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = 'mc',
  id    = 'vehicle_ownership',
  label = "Do you own a vehicle?",
  option = c(
    "Yes" = "yes",
    "No"  = "no"
  )
)
```

--- cars

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "trip_frequency",
  label  = "How often do you take the car for each kind of trip?",
  row    = c(
    "Getting to work or school" = "work_school",
    "The weekly food shop"      = "food_shop"
  ),
  option = c(
    "Never"     = "never",
    "Some days" = "some_days",
    "Most days" = "most_days"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = 'numeric',
  id    = 'weekly_km',
  label = "Roughly how many kilometres do you drive in a normal week?"
)
```

--- end

```{r}
sd_close()
```
